_relationship_to_v_repro_12: Companion package. V-Repro 12 (CLOSED 2026-05-07, 11/11 PASS) is paper-canonical voxelwise routing-ablation test (MI r=0.165 top-5%, matched-dim controls). V-Repro 26 adds per-region cross-subject LOSO BOLD ceiling at the cycle-17 ckpt_bold scale. Different granularity (per-region vs voxelwise), different metric (ceiling vs encoder), complementary evidence.

per_region_ceiling_ds003720._description: Per-region cross-subject inter-rater predictability ceiling on ds003720 N=4 paper-canonical cohort (sub-001, sub-003, sub-004, sub-005); cycle-17 ckpt_bold 6150 TRs per subject (15 runs × 410 TRs at TR=1.5s)
per_region_ceiling_ds003720._interpretation: ds003720 BOLD shows reliable cross-subject stimulus-driven structure at N=4 (15-16/21 regions pass effect floor + BH-FDR q<0.05). hippocampus +0.354 is the strongest cross-subject ceiling — reflects the dataset's 540-clip stimulus-presentation paradigm engaging memory + clip-recognition systems.

saturation_ds003720._description: Saturation verdict per region: MI cycle-17 per-clip encoder r (cycle-17 ridge LOSO) vs per-TR cross-subject ceiling
saturation_ds003720._scale_caveat: Encoder r computed at per-clip scale (cycle-17 Ridge LOSO over clips). Ceiling computed at per-TR scale. Different temporal granularities; saturation comparison is qualitative not strict.
saturation_ds003720._note: Two EXCEEDS regions (OFC, TP) have near-zero or negative ceiling; their EXCEEDS verdict is an artifact of small denominator, not a substantive paradigm finding.

paradigm_comparison_with_v_repro_25._description: Direct comparison between ds002725 N=17 (V-Repro 25) and ds003720 N=4 (this V-Repro 26)
paradigm_comparison_with_v_repro_25._interpretation: Both datasets show reliable cross-subject stimulus-driven BOLD per region. ds002725 N=17 continuous-listening paradigm produces 16/21 ceiling-saturating MI encoder; ds003720 N=4 sparse-clip paradigm produces 5/21 ceiling-saturating (lower N power + per-clip vs per-TR scale mismatch). The complementary finding: BOTH paradigms confirm per-region BOLD reliability, and the ceiling values are similar magnitude (0.3-0.45 top regions) despite very different cohort sizes.

tolerance._note: Tolerance is wider than V-Repro 25 because N=4 cohort produces wider CI variation. n_pass_min=12 = paper baseline 16 - 4.

stimulus_metadata.task: Sparse-clip presentation, 540 clips × ~15s each, 10 genres × 24 clips
stimulus_metadata.bold_aggregation_method: Cycle-17 Harvard-Oxford 4mm γ-tier spheres around MI MNI centroids (preserves 26-region atlas alignment with V-Repro 11 mech×region test on ds002725)
